title: Topic 18
japanese_text: 先月の<u>異動で</u>、<u>同期</u>のAさんが入社３年目で<u>主任</u>に<u>昇進した</u>。Aさんとは入社以来何かと<u>張り合って</u>きたが、私はいまだに自分の仕事を<u>こなす</u>のに<u>精一杯で</u>、<u>右往左往する</u>ことばかりだ。
english_translation: After the personnel transfer last month, Mr. A, a contemporary of mine, was promoted to manager in his third year with the company. I've been competing with Mr. A since we both joined the company, but I'm doing my utmost just managing my own work, so I'm always going every which way.

annotated_words.meaning_en: contemporary, same year (of entering or joining)
moving about in confusion, go every which way
